$comment: Hint book for scripts/model_router.py: each job names a provider, a model line and the capabilities it needs, never a model id. The router picks the newest active, generally available model in that line at least 14 days old from the provider's live list. default_alias names the scripts/model_registry.json alias used offline. Every rule carries the page it was read from and the date.

ai-visibility.probe.why: Asks the model the brand's buyer questions and checks whether the brand is named; a mid-tier line is what most people meet in Claude, and the job needs no special capability.
